===Levels 1–20: Leather items===
From level 1 to 20, craft the highest-level leather item available. [[Leather]] currently costs {{Coins|{{GEP|Leather}}}} each and all items only require one leather to craft. In order to craft any leather items, you need a [[needle]] and some [[thread]]. Since each thread is good for around 5 uses, to get to level 20 with this method, you will need around 50 [[thread]].

This will require a total of 215 leather, for a total cost of {{Coins|{{GEP|Leather|215}}}}. Every leather item is created in 3 ticks (1.8 seconds), so the total creation time for all 215 leather items is 645 ticks (387 seconds).
